debate.key_bull_argument: ADX 42.91 confirms strong downtrend structure, RSI rising from 36.64 and CMF bullish cross suggest early momentum recovery, with extreme fear (24/10) presenting classic contrarian setup near support at 86.6152.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price remains below all major moving averages (9/21/50/200), MACD histogram deeply negative with no crossover, ichimoku bearish structure, macro environment severely unfavourable (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, strong dollar), and earnings event risk in 46 days make this a high-risk entry with weak technical conviction.
